text:
I can't call this asset "deforestation-free," because the tool doesn't make compliance findings. What it shows is that no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected within ASSET-E (438.6 ha) between 2021 and 2025. Valid observations covered 100% of the asset.

Context:
- Hansen data shows 34.5 ha of tree cover in 2000, but the JRC map shows no forest in 2020 (0 ha). So little or no forest was present at the 2020 baseline.
- Hansen's series runs through 2025, so the whole claim period was observed.

Limits:
- Changes under 0.5 ha, at edges, or narrower than the 30 m pixels may be missed, so this doesn't prove that no change happened at all.
- It says nothing about anything outside 2021-2025.
- It is not an EUDR or other regulatory determination.

Also note that the MGAP 2021 source was unavailable. The result is based on Hansen and JRC only.
